chose: The quest subscriber marks each award it judged in a questsJudged table, and the XP moment holds back a kudos decided in the last ten minutes until its awards are marked, as it holds back unrecorded XP; quests carry hoggie from their reward's catalogue version and the moment plays only those
over: Accepting a lost beat when a page reads between the XP and quest subscribers, or moving the quest subscriber into the XP subscriber's transaction, or checking the Monday path at read time
because: XP and quests are separate subscribers of a kudos with no ordering bound, so a read between them ended the moment past the kudos and lost its quest beat for good; one insert per award off the giving mutation fixes it without coupling progression to quests, and a new table keeps main deployable on revert; the read-time path check gave unlock-path quests a hoggie beat once the member moved onto the Monday path
